neighbourSwapLive.finding: The ring is re-fitted to the drawing surface from the runtime's own scene pose every time the layout/pose changes, so in a settled world the mouths do not drift under a stationary pointer: after a 32 s hold and six viewport re-fits the pixel still raycast to the same mouth. A live neighbour-under-the-release-pixel swap is therefore not producible through a still pointer in this build.
neighbourSwapLive.whatIsProven: The code path never re-picks a portal at release (pressOwnership.resolvePress returns the claimed press), the unit tests cover moves inside/outside the threshold, and Mission 5.4B.9 landed 10/10 with claim==resolution.

subsequentIndependentTap.finding: Round 1 completed and cleared its ownership. Round 2's press reached no mouth (claim null, onSelect 0) - a delivery miss after the return to the core view, not a refusal: the ownership guard would have produced a 'duplicate'/'busy' refusal record, and none was written.
